notes_for_editor: Two sources. The Forest Lookouts 1910 note is clear. The Lake County list has one entry under the FIR TIMBER BUTTE heading (Sec 2 T34S R18E, '1910's - Patrol lookout', no structure given). Its 1933 emergency lookout at Sec 23 T38S R16E is listed under FISHHOLE MOUNTAIN, and the 'first three listings ... western end of the butte' comment belongs to FOX BUTTE; neither is used, and the story no longer mentions them. The section differs (Forest Lookouts 34S-18E-01; list Sec 2), and the story says so. The list URL is the blog home page, not a page for this entry. Not in the firelookout.org Oregon county list. A search snippet (not read) says the forest is now the Fremont-Winema National Forest; check before publishing the agency name.
